title: Library loans desk (AI-only run task L1)

content.audience: Synthetic study task for the thesis AI-only run: a small library replaying a day-by-day desk log
content.problem_statement: Replay a library desk log of books, members, loans, returns, reservations and payments; refuse commands the rules do not allow, charge late fines, hold returned books for the next reservation, and print the final state as text or JSON. This is a frozen synthetic task for the thesis AI-only run, not a customer product.

user_flows.name: Replay a log
steps: Pipe the desk log into the CLI
Read the refused commands and the final state of every book and member

user_flows.name: Fines and payments
steps: Return books late and pay fines

user_flows.name: Reservations
steps: Reserve a book that is out
Read that the returned book is held for the first reserver

user_flows.name: JSON report
steps: Read the same state as JSON

user_flows.name: Bad input
steps: Pipe a malformed line or pass a bad argument
Read the error and the exit status

scope: Python 3.8+ standard library only, entry point src/main.py, all code under src. No files, network, environment variables or third-party packages. Amounts are exact cents, never floating point

Required structure: a package src/loans with __init__.py and the modules money, script, desk, report and cli, each with at least one top-level function (a def at module level; a def only inside a class does not count)

src/main.py imports from loans, and each module is imported by main.py or by another module of the package. Run as python3 -I src/main.py, which does not put src on the import path: main.py must add its own directory to sys.path before importing loans
Read all of stdin and split it into lines on \n, numbered from 1 counting every line. Split each line into whitespace-separated fields; skip a line with no fields or whose first field starts with #

Commands (exact field counts): BOOK ID TITLE... (TITLE is every later field joined by single spaces, at least one), MEMBER ID NAME, DAY N, LEND BOOK MEMBER, RETURN BOOK, RESERVE BOOK MEMBER, PAY MEMBER AMOUNT

Book ids are B followed by 1 to 4 digits not starting with 0; member ids are M followed by 1 to 4 digits not starting with 0; NAME is 1 to 20 ASCII letters; N is 1 to 4 digits not starting with 0; AMOUNT is digits (0, or up to 6 digits not starting with 0), a dot and exactly 2 digits

Any other line (unknown command, wrong field count, a bad id, name, number or amount) is malformed: print exactly error: line N: malformed for the first one, print nothing else, and exit 1. The whole log is checked before anything is applied

Commands apply in order. A refused command changes nothing and is recorded with its line number and reason. Reasons are checked in the order listed for each command, and the first that applies is used

The day starts at 1. BOOK: duplicate if the book id exists; else the book is added, available. MEMBER: duplicate if the member id exists; else added, owing 0.00. DAY N: day-backwards if N is less than the current day; else the day becomes N

LEND: unknown-book, unknown-member, not-available (the book is on loan), held (the book is held for a different member), limit (the member already has 3 books on loan), owes-fines (the member owes more than 5.00)
A LEND that is not refused puts the book on loan to the member, due on the current day plus 14, and any hold on the book ends
RETURN: unknown-book, not-on-loan. Else the borrower is fined 0.25 for each day the current day is past the due day, at most 5.00 per return, added to what they owe
After a RETURN the book is no longer on loan; if its reservation queue is not empty, the first member in it is removed from the queue and the book is held for them. Holds never expire

RESERVE: unknown-book, unknown-member, not-on-loan (the book is neither on loan nor held), already-yours (the member is its borrower or the member it is held for), duplicate (the member is already in its queue). Else the member joins the end of the queue

PAY: unknown-member, overpay (the amount is more than the member owes). Else the amount is subtracted from what they owe. Arguments are none or exactly --json; anything else prints exactly invalid arguments, then \n, and exits 2

Text report (no arguments): first one line per refused command, in order: line N: refused: REASON. Then day D. Then one line per book in order of the number in its id (see the next item), then one line per member in the same order

Book line: ID TITLE: available, or ID TITLE: held for MEMBER, or ID TITLE: on loan to MEMBER due DUE, followed by (overdue K) when the current day is K > 0 days past the due day. If its queue is not empty, add ; queue and the queued member ids in order, separated by comma and space

Member line: ID NAME: loans L, owes X.XX. Each output line ends with \n. Exit 0. --json prints instead one JSON value, exactly as Python's json.dumps(value, indent=2) writes it, then \n: an object with keys day, books, members, refused in that order

JSON books: in report order, objects with keys id, title, status (available, held or on_loan), member (the borrower, or the member it is held for, else null), due (a number while on loan, else null), queue (a list of member ids)
JSON members: objects with keys id, name, loans (a number), owes (a string such as 0.75), in report order. JSON refused: objects with keys line and reason, in order

risks.risk: Six tasks written by one author do not establish general build quality
risks.mitigation: Report results only for these frozen tasks, this route, model and role prompts, as the AI-only arm alone

risks.risk: Held-out cases leak to the builder
risks.mitigation: The studio hides held-out studio cases from builder and reviewer; extended cases are never entered into the studio; the repository copy is never sent to runtime roles

obligations: Keep this frozen version unchanged; a change needs a new version and is reported as a deviation
maintenance.review_interval: Not reviewed during the run; frozen until the thesis is submitted
